section_4b_pre_print_debates.debate_title: Debate 1: NovaSeq X Reagent Pull-Through vs. Re-Sequencing Price Deflation
section_4b_pre_print_debates.bull_vs_bear_framing: Bulls argue that the lower cost-per-gigabase of the NovaSeq X ($200 per genome) is unlocking massive population-scale sequencing projects and clinical liquid biopsy screening that will drive overall consumables volume higher. Bears argue that lower prices per gigabase cannibalize existing sequencing revenue before volume elasticities fully kick in, resulting in sluggish near-term top-line revenue growth.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: Analyst Conference Call Focus: What is the current utilization elasticity across installed NovaSeq X instruments, and are customers increasing gigabase volume sufficiently to offset lower unit pricing?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.debate_title: Debate 2: Mid-Throughput Competition & Emerging Sequencing Entrants
section_4b_pre_print_debates.bull_vs_bear_framing: Bulls point to Illumina's overwhelming 80%+ market share, vast patent portfolio, and ingrained bioinformatics pipelines as an unassailable clinical moat. Bears warn that alternative sequencing technologies (Element Biosciences, Ultima Genomics, PacBio) are winning academic mid-throughput benchtop placements by competing aggressively on reagent pricing.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: Analyst Conference Call Focus: How are NextSeq 1000/2000 win rates trending in the mid-throughput segment, and what defensive reagent bundling strategies is Illumina implementing?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.debate_title: Debate 3: Free Cash Flow Re-Acceleration & Capital Return Post-Grail
section_4b_pre_print_debates.bull_vs_bear_framing: Bulls celebrate that the completed Grail spinoff eliminates ~$600M in annual operational dilution, restoring True FCF past $750M+ annualized and enabling share buybacks and debt paydown. Bears caution that lingering EU regulatory fines and tax indemnities from the transaction could present one-off cash obligations.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: Analyst Conference Call Focus: What is the board's capital allocation priority between debt deleveraging and share repurchases now that Grail cash burn has ceased?
